description: This file defines data structures and a class managing the state of a Watch app's inbox, including message consumption, persistence, and local notifications.

classes.name: WatchInboxStore
classes.description: An observable, actor-class managing the state and message notifications for the watch inbox.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Processes an incoming message, updates state, and triggers notifications.

methods.name: deliveryKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for message deduplication.

methods.name: mapHapticRisk
methods.description: Maps message risk level to haptic feedback type.

methods.name: makeReplyDraft
methods.description: Creates a reply draft based on an action.

methods.name: markReplySending
methods.description: Updates state when a reply is being sent.

methods.name: markReplyResult
methods.description: Updates state after reply send attempt, with success or failure.

methods.name: postLocalNotification
methods.description: Creates and schedules a local notification and plays haptic feedback.
